0.28.0.title: New ArchitectureDiagram component
added: ArchitectureDiagram — a vertical diagram of layers: blocks (a title, a description, an optional link with an icon) joined by arrows with an optional description of the connection. A block with children is a row of highlighted tiles (modules). The component knows neither the app's content nor its icons (`linkIcon` is passed by the page).

0.27.7.title: State logic of Gallery and Chat extracted into hooks

0.27.6.title: A shared interactivity base for buttons
added: internal/interactiveBase.ts — INTERACTIVE_BASE_CLASSES: the cursor and the disabled state shared by every `*Button` (previously copied, or not handled at all in some variants).
changed: Button, ToolbarButton, IconButton, RailButton, ChatLauncher and the internal CloseButton now use the shared base instead of each defining the cursor/disabled again. The look is unchanged — none of these components had been used with `disabled`, so this is purely additive.

0.27.5.title: New IconButton (with a border) next to ToolbarButton
added: IconButton — a square button with an icon and a border for controls inside a card (e.g. the carousel arrows).
changed: The former `IconButton` (borderless, toolbars: Terminal, Explorer, Assistant) renamed to `ToolbarButton`/`ToolbarButtonSize` — no change in look or behaviour.
Gallery: the previous/next arrows now use `IconButton` instead of the local `controlButtonClasses`.

0.27.4.title: A consistent structure of design-system subcomponents
changed: Subcomponents of Guide, InfoCard, List, Menu, SolutionExplorer, StatusBar, Tabs and TitleBar were extracted into their components directories, together with their own types.
Public exports and behaviour were kept; ListSearchRow remains a private element of List, and the shared tree-indent calculation lives in utils.

0.27.3.title: DataCard subcomponents in separate folders
changed: DataCardAction, DataCardList and DataCardRow together with their types were moved to DataCard/components. Public exports, props and the look were kept.

0.27.2.title: Component constants in .consts.ts files
changed: Static maps of classes, tones and sizes and the configuration of 17 components were moved to their .consts.ts files; the look and the public props are unchanged.
The token generator reads the Text maps from Text.consts.ts, keeping the recognition of selected variants in dependent components.

0.27.1.title: Guide focus trap: hidden elements and Shift+Tab from outside the card
fixed: The Guide focus trap now skips hidden elements (display: none or a hidden ancestor) and not only disabled ones — the selector did not filter visibility by itself.
Tab/Shift+Tab with the focus outside the card now correctly lands on the first/last element of the cycle — Shift+Tab used to land one element too early (the second-to-last instead of the last).

0.27.0.title: Button/Link/StatusBarButton contracts, tab order and keyboard
added: CardHeading: a small label at the top of a bordered card — extracted from Gallery and ArchitectureCard.

The focus-ring and focus-ring-tight utilities (a 2px/2px and 1px/1px focus ring in the accent colour) — they replace the same hand-assembled list of classes that was previously repeated in a dozen components.

The --radius-xl-plus (9px) and --duration-140 tokens — named, shared definitions for values repeated unchanged (ChatLauncher, Menu, EmptyEditor; Button, IconButton, Panel, StatusBar, Field, ProfileLinks).
changed: ButtonProps, LinkProps and StatusBarButtonProps are now unions of a button variant and a link variant (…AsButtonProps | …AsLinkProps) with the proper native attributes and ref for each, instead of one type described by AnchorHTMLAttributes also for <button>. disabled is no longer available together with href (Button), and likewise expanded with href (StatusBarButton) — this narrows the contract; existing calls without such combinations keep working.
Button sets type="button" by default (keeping an explicit type="submit"), so a button in the non-href variant does not submit a form by accident.
Gallery now uses CardHeading instead of its own copy of the same header.
Input and Textarea share the internal Field (the label) and the base field classes (FIELD_BASE_CLASSES) instead of two almost identical implementations.

Tab reordering (useTabsReorder) no longer moves DOM nodes during the drag — the visual order goes through flex order/transform, and React remains the only owner of the actual order, set only by onReorder. EditorProvider.reorderTabs validates that the new order is a permutation of the currently open tabs.

Terminal: Tab captures the key only when it actually completes something — Shift+Tab and Tab without a match move the focus like everywhere else instead of blocking it. Added aria-keyshortcuts="Tab" on the command field.
Closing a tab is now visible also when focused by keyboard, not only on hover; both tab buttons have a focus-ring.
The focus trap in Guide covers all standard focusable elements (links, form fields, tabindex), not only <button>.
ProjectCard colours the label/title/description through the color prop of Text (TextColor.Accent/Heading/Muted) instead of raw text-* classes, which happen to match the existing colour scale.

The API documentation generator (parseTypes.ts) now recognises multi-line interface declarations, local shared (non-exported) interfaces and unions of two interfaces (getUnion) — the Button/Link/StatusBarButton API tables are complete again. The token generator (tokens.ts) follows a component's local imports and expands tokens from custom @utility rules, so Input/Textarea (through Field) and every component using focus-ring* have a full token list again.
fixed: Escape during a tab drag actually cancels the gesture (without changing the order) — previously only a comment in the code claimed so. Cleanup on unmount now cancels all animations of the neighbouring tabs, not just the dragged one.
The terminal height handle now has a visible focus ring (previously outline-none with no focus state at all).

0.26.0.title: Light theme and a theme switch
added: The light theme (theme/light.css): grey surfaces (a mid shade, not white), the same tokens as dark, a darker accent for contrast on a light background, an inverted tint and softer shadows; text contrast measured and no worse than in the dark theme

useTheme() and setTheme() — the current theme and changing it, with the choice remembered in localStorage, shared by the app and the documentation; initTheme() applies the saved theme and follows changes in other tabs
StatusBarSwitch: the icon option in StatusBarSwitchOption — an icon instead of a label (the label then serves as the accessible name)
The highlight token (a light edge in shadows; tint can now be inverted in the light theme) and the --theme-icon-invert variable (inverting dark single-colour icons)
changed: color-scheme is set in the theme files; check:theme now also compares the --theme-* variables
Technology icons cannot have a colour in the URL: dark icons are marked monochrome

0.25.0.title: Themes: all colours from tokens
added: The theme mechanism: the theme/base.css, theme/dark.css and theme/utilities.css files; the theme is chosen by the data-theme attribute on <html>
ThemeName, DEFAULT_THEME, THEME_ATTRIBUTE, isThemeName and applyTheme, and readThemeColor (a token value for SVG data URIs and canvas)
The tint and scrim overlay tokens: shadows are composed from them (color-mix), so a theme defines only these two colours

The utilities bg-stage-glow, bg-hero-card, bg-accent-wash and bg-target-mark, and the shadows shadow-menu, shadow-chat, shadow-launcher, shadow-drag, shadow-hero, shadow-logo, shadow-inset-highlight, shadow-glow-success and shadow-glow-accent

Tokens for colours that were hard-coded until now: accent-line-*, accent-surface-hover, accent-muted, content-tinted, content-tinted-strong, success-content-soft, success-indicator, decor-lilac, filetype-markdown, indicator-idle, surface-pressed-strong, line-hover, chat-user-line
changed: Colour tokens renamed to the {group}-{role} taxonomy: surface-*, line-*, content-*, accent-*, link-*, success|warning|danger|info-*, decor-*; classes change accordingly (e.g. bg-list → bg-surface-panel, text-text-dim → text-content-muted, border-border-5 → border-line-emphasis)

The text scale was tidied: 17 text-* tokens merged into 12 content-* steps; 80 [#hex] literals replaced by tokens (the largest colour shift 11/255, mostly in the purple shades in Chat, Terminal, Menu and Guide)
The default Tailwind palette is disabled (--color-*: initial): bg-white, text-red-500 etc. no longer compile
The page background in index.html and docs.html uses color-scheme instead of a hard-coded colour
